result.title: FisherDistill: Diffusion Distribution Distillation via Closed-Form Fisher Critics
result.summary: Recent advances in diffusion distillation have enabled high-quality image generation in only one or a few network function evaluations (NFEs). Despite their efficiency, aggressively distilled generators often retain a residual distribution gap from their multi-step teachers, motivating recent methods to introduce adversarial refinement with a learned discriminator. In this work, we ask whether such refinement necessarily requires a learned adversarial discriminator. We introduce \textbf{FisherDistill}, a simple alternative based on Fisher linear discriminant analysis. Using intermediate representations from the frozen teacher, we estimate the first- and second-order statistics of real and generated samples and derive a closed-form Fisher direction that maximally separates their feature distributions relative to within-class variation. This direction provides a lightweight refinement signal that complements the original distillation objective without requiring an additional adversarial discriminator or its optimization loop. Across multiple distillation frameworks, our approach consistently improves generation quality over their respective distilled baselines and substantially closes the gap to adversarially refined counterparts. Code: https://bhosalems.github.io/FisherDistill/

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向扩散模型少步蒸馏，提出用冻结教师中间表示估计真实与生成样本的一、二阶统计量，导出闭式 Fisher 判别方向作为轻量精炼信号，替代对抗判别器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用教师中间层特征的类内/类间统计构造闭式判别方向，可能为 LVR 中比较不同 latent 表示的内容与深度差异、设计无判别器的表示级训练信号提供可核查的统计工具，但原文并不研究多模态推理。
